title: Implicit Feature Reweighting for Label-Free Graph Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.29571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph-level out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization is critical for deploying graph neural networks in real-world applications where distribution shifts are inevitable. Existing approaches typically require class labels during representation learning to decide which substructures are predictive, limiting their applicability. We propose SCARCE, a label-free representation-learning framework that yields distribution-shift-robust graph representations from an environment partition of the training graphs alone, whether that partition comes from dataset metadata or, when none is available, from clustering a self-supervised embedding. Our method operates in two stages: (1) a variational graph autoencoder is warm-started for graph reconstruction; and (2) an adversarial confusion mechanism forces the encoder to produce representations from which a discriminator cannot distinguish environments, while preserving graph-reconstruction fidelity. translated_title: 面向无标签图泛化的隐式特征重加权
translated_abstract: 图级别的分布外泛化对于在分布偏移不可避免的真实世界应用中部署图神经网络至关重要。现有方法通常在表示学习过程中需要类别标签来判断哪些子结构具有预测性，这限制了它们的适用性。我们提出了SCARCE，这是一个无标签的表示学习框架，仅从训练图的环境划分中即可获得对分布偏移鲁棒的图表示，该划分既可以来自数据集元数据，也可以在没有元数据可用时通过对自监督嵌入进行聚类获得。我们的方法分为两个阶段：（1）预热启动变分图自编码器用于图重建；（2）对抗混淆机制迫使编码器产生判别器无法据此区分环境的表示，同时保持图重建的保真度。
tldr: 提出了无标签表示学习框架SCARCE，通过变分图自编码器与对抗混淆机制，仅利用训练图的环境划分即可学习到对分布偏移鲁棒的图表示，无需类别标签即实现图级别的分布外泛化。
en_tdlr: SCARCE is a label-free representation-learning framework that learns distribution-shift-robust graph representations from environment partitions of training graphs via a variational graph autoencoder and an adversarial confusion mechanism, achieving graph-level OOD generalization without requiring class labels.
